summary: Implemented load_decathalon_datalist in monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py, exported it from monai/data/__init__.py, added a "Decathalon DataLoader" autofunction subsection under Utilities in docs/source/data.rst, and added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (test_seg_values, test_cls_values, test_seg_no_basedir, test_seg_no_labels). Nothing was run or committed, as instructed. Black and flake8 were not run; I checked only that no line exceeds 120 columns. Choices beyond the spec: items missing image or label are passed through unchanged; a non-object top-level JSON or a non-list value under the key raises ValueError; items are copied rather than mutated.
